Element.Description: Curve controlling the spot-light cutoff angle. Evaluated while the light is active and LightType selects a spot light.
End time for the SpotlightAngle curve. At this time, SpotlightAngleLoops either resets the curve timer to zero or holds it at this value.
Restarts the SpotlightAngle curve at time zero when its timer reaches SpotlightAngleDuration. When disabled, the timer stays at SpotlightAngleDuration.
